 A United flight at Fort Lauderdale airport in Florida. Photograph: Joe Raedle/Getty Images View image in fullscreen A United flight at Fort Lauderdale airport in Florida. Photograph: Joe Raedle/Getty Images US news United Airlines says it is working to fix ‘widespread’ system outage
 Outage at major airline comes just three days after FAA issued rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights
 Guardian staff Mon 16 Nov 2026 17.19 EST Last modified on Mon 16 Nov 2026 17.22 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google United ⁠Airlines said on ⁠Monday ⁠that it was ​experiencing ⁠a widespread system ⁠outage, just three days after the Federal ⁠Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights.
 “We’re ‌aware of the widespread system outage, ‌and our teams are working ​hard to get ⁠things back ​up and ​running ​as soon ​as possible,” ‌United ​said in a post ​on X.
 More details soon …
